description:
It seems you’ll soon be able to access most of OpenAI’s services in one place on your computer. The Wall Street Journal reports that the company’s CEO of Applications, Fidji Simo, revealed in an internal memo that OpenAI is set to launch a new superapp for computers.

The superapp will combine the ChatGPT AI chatbot, the Codex AI coding app, and the Atlas AI browser into a single, unified application. It’s unclear whether other OpenAI services, such as the AI video generator Sora, will also be added to the superapp.

title: OpenAI is developing a unified AI ‘superapp’ for desktop users

description:
The demand for one-page websites is skyrocketing thanks to the need for things like landing pages, portfolios, and small business sites. It can be daunting to dive head-first into web design if you don’t have any experience. Thankfully, you can use a website builder service like Carrd to create a one-page site in a matter of minutes.

Carrd fits a nice niche that other website design platforms such as WordPress and Wix, both of which require a certain level of expertise, have grown away from. Believe me, most of my job as a writer and editor is done in WordPress, and I’m still learning about how to use it.

Carrd keeps it as simple as possible, which is why I like it. I’ve even recommended it to a less-than-tech-savvy relative who needed a way to create an online portfolio site—and if they can figure it out
title: Build your own website in minutes with this online tool
